sbh2.0:2.34: Printed *sakṛd-*; read *saptakṛd-* (13.1; Xuanzang 極七返有).
sbh2.0:2.38: Printed list omits *anabhisaṁskāraparinirvāyī*, the twenty-second of the twenty-eight (15.1; Xuanzang 無行般涅槃).
sbh2.0:5.4: Printed text omits the delusion member (*mohanīye vā vastuni*); Xuanzang has it (所愚事).
sbh2.0:5.13: Printed *rajyaṁ rāgam*, corrupt; the sense follows Xuanzang 起微劣貪 (T1579 juan 26).
sbh2.0:10.5: Printed *śrāmaṇya[bhāva]m*, the *bhāva* supplied by Shukla in a damaged place; read *śrāmaṇyaphalam* (11.3; Xuanzang 沙門果).
sbh2.0:11.6: Printed *parato ’vavādānuśāsanīmārgasya*, repeated from 10.8, is not rendered; Xuanzang’s definition (見至) lacks it.
sbh2.0:13.5: Printed text omits the definition of the family-to-family person; Xuanzang has it in two kinds, divine and human (天家家、人家家), the ‘both’ of 13.6 (T1579 juan 26).
sbh2.0:14.9: Printed *uparato*; read *upanato* (14.11; Xuanzang 未趣生有).
sbh2.0:14.10: Printed *aśubhānāṁ*, corrupt; the sense follows Xuanzang 鐵摶 (T1579 juan 26).
sbh2.0:24.9: Printed *karkaśendriyaḥ, aparuddhendriyaḥ*; read *akarkaśendriyaḥ, aparuṣendriyaḥ* (24.27; Xuanzang 不澀、不麁).
sbh2.0:25.14: Printed *hastasaṁbādhika*, corrupt; the sense follows Xuanzang 以手代言 (also 88.42).
sbh2.0:26.11: Printed *unnatendriya* twice (bracketed by Shukla as a repetition); Xuanzang 散亂 has a third member, ‘scattered’. Printed *sātāpika-*, corrupt; the sense follows Xuanzang 父母、眷屬 ‘parents, kin’.
sbh2.0:26.15: Printed *-nuvivedhyaś ca jyaś ca*, corrupt; read *durvivejyaś ca* (24.10; Xuanzang 難使遠離).
sbh2.0:26.30: Printed *cha du rita-vākkarmāntī*, corrupt; the sense follows Xuanzang 語業誤失.
sbh2.0:31.1: Printed *mauladhyānalābhino* (31.1, 31.2), as in 31.3–4; Xuanzang has 未得根本靜慮 ‘not having attained the basic dhyāna’ for the painful pair.
sbh2.0:33.16: Printed list omits two members after the upon-rebirth one; Xuanzang has 無行般涅槃、有行般涅槃, the without-effort and with-effort ones (15.1–15.4).
sbh2.0:45.9: Printed *āryā ca*; read *yā ca* (Xuanzang 除苦苦性 has no ‘noble’). Printed *duḥkhāḥ (duḥkha)sahagatāḥ*, the second word queried by Shukla; the sense follows Xuanzang 不苦不樂受俱行.
sbh2.0:48.2: Printed *dharmasattvaṁ*, corrupt; the sense follows Xuanzang 法義.
sbh2.0:53.7: Printed *ānupūrvīṣu viśuddhaśīlasya vipratisāraḥ*; read *ānupūrvī suviśuddhaśīlasyāvipratisāraḥ* (53.8; Xuanzang 善清淨 … 無憂悔).
sbh2.0:53.18: Printed *adhikārārthenādhikārārthena* (Shukla: a repetition); read *adhikārārthenādhikārthena* (53.26; Xuanzang 所趣義故，最勝義故).
sbh2.0:53.24: Printed text omits the question and the first member, *yā cādhiśīlaṁ śikṣā*; Xuanzang 云何最勝義？謂若增上戒學.
sbh2.0:56.7: Printed *niyantir*; read *nikāntir* (Xuanzang 愛著; so too 56.26).
sbh2.0:56.10: Printed *ra[me]ṣu*, a letter lost by pin-hole and supplied by Shukla; read *ratneṣu* (Xuanzang 寶).
sbh2.0:56.11: Printed text omits the fault itself; Xuanzang 猶預疑惑 ‘doubt’.
sbh2.0:56.14: Printed *anvārabdha-*; read *atyārabdha-* (56.16; Xuanzang 太猛精進).
sbh2.0:56.20: Syllables lost by pin-hole after *amātrayā* (Shukla’s note); Xuanzang 於諸言說 ‘in speech’.
sbh2.0:56.30: Printed list omits *anityasaṁjñā*, nine of the ten it counts (Xuanzang 無常想).
sbh2.0:58.11: Printed *dauṣṭhu[lyaṁ, prītiḥ] praśrabdhir*, letters lost by pin-hole and supplied by Shukla; read *dauṣṭhulyapratipraśrabdhiḥ* (57.6; Xuanzang 止息身心麁重).
sbh2.0:58.15: Printed *tadā [cātma]cetaḥ-*, supplied by Shukla where the MS is illegible; the sense follows Xuanzang 內心寂止.
sbh2.0:58.28: Printed text omits a clause; Xuanzang 便生歡喜；若知未斷 (he rejoices; knowing them not abandoned).
sbh2.0:59.36: Printed *arhatsampata(da)ḥ*; read *arhatsaṁmataḥ* (59.40; Xuanzang 謂之是阿羅漢).
sbh2.0:59.38: Printed *api adhvādenteṣu gredhaṁ nigamayaṁ vā varttate vā …*, corrupt, letters lost (Shukla conjectures *grāmo nigamo vā*); the sense follows Xuanzang 戀著親愛，隨順而轉。為多招引.
sbh2.0:59.84: Printed text repeats *ity ayaṁ caturvidhaś chandaḥ* from 59.83 (Shukla’s note).
sbh2.0:59.99: Printed text repeats 59.94–95, then *ālayadīrghatā tatra*, corrupt; Xuanzang 勤心勇猛，審決精進 ends with 59.97–98.
sbh2.0:59.126: Printed list omits *niśchidravāhanaḥ* (Shukla’s note; 59.139; Xuanzang 無間運轉作意).
sbh2.0:60.12: Printed list omits *nidānanimittam* (Shukla’s note; 61.1; Xuanzang 因緣相).
sbh2.0:61.7: Printed *saṁghahā*, corrupt, with no privative, and *vyāpāda-*, read *vyāpāra-*; the sense follows Xuanzang 他不惱觸 … 功用作.
sbh2.0:64.9: Printed *-ālambanapramāṇatayā*; read *-ālambanāpramāṇatayā* (64.4; Xuanzang 所緣無量).
sbh2.0:67.34: Printed *prahāṇāya*, Shukla’s filling of a pin-hole; read *nirvāṇāya* (Xuanzang 涅槃道).
sbh2.0:67.40: Printed *vipaśyanāyāṁ prayuktaḥ paścātpura*, corrupt; the heading follows Xuanzang 上下想者.
sbh2.0:67.43: Printed *paścātpunaḥ saṁjñī*; read *puraḥpaścātsaṁjñā* (Xuanzang 前後想者).
sbh2.0:67.90: Printed list of the bases corrupt (*śraddhā-* twice); the four follow Xuanzang 欲勤心觀三摩地. The printed powers lack *vīrya* (Xuanzang 精進力).
sbh2.0:69.7: Printed *śrutamayī vā prajñā bhāvanāmayī vā*, two of the three (69.6, 77.68); *cintāmayī* is lost (Xuanzang 思所成).
sbh2.0:73.2: Printed list omits *vigatarāgaṁ cittaṁ* (75.3; Xuanzang 離貪心).
sbh2.0:73.24: Printed *vigatarāgaṁ*, bracketed by Shukla as a later hand’s addition; not in Xuanzang.
sbh2.0:75.7: After *vastuni* Shukla marks a gap: the close of the delusion definition and the definition of mind without delusion are lost; Xuanzang has both (癡纏所纏 … 離癡心).
sbh2.0:75.46: Printed *dharmavinaya-* (also 83.13); read *dharmavicaya-* (Xuanzang 擇法覺支). *prīti* is lost from the list (83.14; Xuanzang 喜).
sbh2.0:75.53: Printed *paraktaṁ*, corrupt; the sense follows Xuanzang 他有情數身色.
sbh2.0:76.7: Printed text repeats 76.3–6 (bracketed by Shukla as a separate hand’s addition).
sbh2.0:76.30: Printed *avijñānakasya* twice; the second read *savijñānakasya* (Xuanzang 有識身色於未來時無識性).
sbh2.0:77.1: Printed *adhyātmaṁ cittaṁ ca bahiḥkāyavipariṇataṁ*; Xuanzang 內表身變異 has no ‘mind’.
sbh2.0:77.14: Printed *sukhe sukham*; read *duḥkhe sukham* (77.17; Xuanzang 苦中計樂).
sbh2.0:77.26: Printed *dharmādharmānudarśino*, from a blurred photograph (Shukla’s note); read *dharmeṣu dharmānudarśino* (Xuanzang 於諸法住循法觀).
sbh2.0:77.32: Printed *sukhaduḥkha ja*, letters indistinct (Shukla’s note); the sense follows Xuanzang 受用苦樂.
sbh2.0:77.36: After *-ārthaṁ* the close of the mind-foundation clause and the opening of the dharma-foundation clause are lost; Xuanzang has both (立心念住 … 立法念住).
sbh2.0:77.65: Printed *kāyavedanādhipateyo*; Xuanzang 身受心法增上 names all four foundations.
sbh2.0:79.8: Printed *yad anutpanneṣu … pūrvam evotpāda*, the last word without ending; the sense follows Xuanzang 已生 … 先已和合.
sbh2.0:79.14: Printed *yenokta-* (twice); read *parokṣa-* (79.15; Xuanzang 不現見境).
sbh2.0:79.22: Printed *samavasthāna-* here and at 79.24, 80.13, 80.17, 80.21, 80.36, 80.37; read *paryavasthāna-* (Xuanzang 纏; cf. 79.132).
sbh2.0:79.56: Printed text repeats 79.58–59 as far as *vyāyacchate*, with that verb for *vīryam ārabhate*; rendered once (Xuanzang has one clause for each class).
sbh2.0:80.4: Printed *ayaṁ …… mīmāṁsāsamādhiḥ*, the gap marked by Shukla; the energy- and mind-concentrations are lost (Xuanzang 勤三摩地、心三摩地).
sbh2.0:80.21: Printed *tv asyāpy*; read *na tv asyāpy* (80.14; Xuanzang 而未永害煩惱隨眠).
sbh2.0:80.27: Printed *-sthānīyānvayāt kuśalataḥ*, corrupt; the sense follows Xuanzang 若能隨順惡不善法，及諸善法.
sbh2.0:80.38: Printed *dharmeṣv anutpanneṣu … dharmā dharma mudā haranti*, corrupt; the sense follows Xuanzang 能生起 … 皆不現行 (the antidotes arisen, the evil dharmas do not occur).
sbh2.0:80.65: Printed *cittābhisaṁkleśaś cittaṁgamatā*; read *cittānabhisaṁkleśaś cittasamatā* (Xuanzang 心無染污、心平等性).
sbh2.0:80.67: Printed *viparokṣayā* twice; read *aviparokṣayā* with *upekṣayā* (Xuanzang 境界不現見思 … 境界現見捨).
sbh2.0:80.72: Printed *ayam upādāya* (Shukla queries *idam*); read *ayam upāyaḥ* (Xuanzang 即彼方便; the four yogas of 59.70).
sbh2.0:83.21: Printed *samyakkarmāntājīvāḥ*; right speech is lost (86.38; Xuanzang 正語、正業、正命).
sbh2.0:86.22: Printed *samyakkarmāntājīvāḥ*; right speech is lost (83.21; Xuanzang 正語、業、命).
sbh2.0:86.24: Printed *āpakānta* (86.24, 86.29, 86.30, 86.37); read *āryakānta* (86.25; Xuanzang 聖所愛戒).
sbh2.0:86.44: Printed *samyagvyāyāmaśamathaḥ*; *śamathaḥ* is stray (86.46) and not rendered.
sbh2.0:86.74: Printed text omits the third position; Xuanzang has 善說法毘奈耶品 (86.80). Printed *vivṛddhākaratvāt*; read *vibandhakaratvāt* (86.83; Xuanzang 障礙聖道令不生).
sbh2.0:88.39: Printed *aprasāda*, corrupt; the sense follows Xuanzang 不生不長.
sbh2.0:88.47: Printed *dṛṣṭi tṛptitā jātā*, letters illegible (Shukla’s note); read *dṛṣṭyṛjutā jātā* (88.44, 88.63; Xuanzang 正直見).
sbh2.0:88.48: Printed *dhi tam āryā[a]śāṭhyatayā*; read *vigatamāyāśāṭhyatayā* (88.53; Xuanzang 遠離誑諂).
sbh2.0:88.50: Printed *anityam anubhava[na]m anityāni*; read *acintyam anubhāvam acintyāni* (Xuanzang 不可思議威德神力、不可思議生處差別).
sbh2.0:89.26: Printed *śajjinaḥ (mārgadeśikāḥ)* after *pratipannā*, intruded from 89.4–5, is not rendered; Xuanzang has no equivalent (活道沙門).
sbh2.0:89.39: Printed *katamaḥ*; read *prathamaḥ* (89.44; Xuanzang 此初沙門).
sbh2.0:90.18: Printed *brahmacaryāt punar dharmāt*; read *’brahmacaryān maithunād dharmāt* (Xuanzang 非梵行習婬欲法).
sbh2.0:92.11: Printed text omits the first member (Xuanzang 欲尋思).
sbh2.0:93.8: Printed *parivrājakopāṇḍuroga*, corrupt; the sense follows Xuanzang 塗灰.
sbh2.0:93.10: Shukla reports the leaf torn (93.10, 93.13, 93.15, 93.19); lost at 93.10 are the eight persons and the four grounds of their establishment, of which 93.11 is the fourth (Xuanzang T1579 juan 29, 0447b13–23).
sbh2.0:93.16: Printed *āptānāṁ*; read *aṣṭānāṁ* (Xuanzang 八種補特伽羅).
sbh2.0:94.13: Printed *niścayaprāptaḥ*, corrupt; the sense follows Xuanzang 得大自在.
sbh2.0:96.3: Printed *yo vītarāgaḥ*; read *yo ’vītarāgaḥ* (96.2; Xuanzang 若未離欲).
sbh2.0:96.9: Printed *pravartante*, corrupt; the sense follows Xuanzang 退捨.
sbh2.0:98.9: Printed *cen na samudāgatāni*; read *cet samudāgatāni* (Xuanzang 諸根雖已積集).
